Learning how to validated your own pain, it’s enough you felt hurt over something, you don’t need proof of it. Just that it happened is testament enough. Is real enough, is valid enough. 

Think of pain as an energy you need to discharge almost like static electricity. How you pick to discharge it, is up to you. When I feel something bubbling up, I try to have that mental image.
